text: But oh, how true it seems!" The blazing fire drew her to it, and she knelt down and held out her hands close to it--so close that the heat made her start back. "A fire I only dreamed wouldn't be HOT," she cried. She sprang up, touched the table, the dishes, the rug; she went to the bed and touched the blankets. She took up the soft wadded dressing-gown, and suddenly clutched it to her breast and held it to her cheek.
